title: Rebalantment
description: Aims to rebalance and shift the enchantment level system, and remove durability, while fully customizable
body:
This mod aims to allow anyone to customize how powerful enchantments are, and their progression as well. With the added bonus of configuring durability. Everything in this mod applies to all mods.

By default, all enchantments' max levels are set to half their normal value, all enchantments have only one level, and durability is removed. So for example, Sharpness will have only the first level, and be as effective as Sharpness II.

The max level can be configured anywhere from 1 to 255, enchantment levels being removed can be disabled, and durability can be turned on or off. Do note, if an item uses durability and only after the setting to remove durability is applied, it will keep its current damage until repaired.

Additionally, this mod adds a new enchantment, and replaces Mending and Unbreaking with two new enchantments:![The latter two replace Mending and Unbreaking respectively.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad8a68fb7d55868c79fba6e82ca74c0f82f3cf2f.png)
